title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role description**  


Who We Are

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees across 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at **www.ust.com**.


Summary

UST is seeking a highly skilled **Senior****Java****Developer** with expertise in **Enterprise****Marketing****Management****(EMM),****SSIS,****Java****Microservices,****and****Azure\-based****enterprise****application****development**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in backend development, enterprise application customization, integration, and data transformation solutions.


The Opportunity
**Job****Title:** Senior Java Developer – EMM \& SSIS  

**Location:** Trivandrum / Hybrid  

**Experience:** 6\+ Years


Mandatory Skills
* Java (Java 8\+)
* Spring Boot
* Microservices Architecture
* Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) Customization
* REST APIs
* SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
* SQL Server
* Enterprise Application Integration
* Azure Cloud
* CI/CD Practices
* JSON \& XML
* Object\-Oriented Design (OOD)

Job Responsibilities

As a **Senior****Java****Developer**, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* Customize, configure, and extend Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) platforms based on business requirements.
* Analyze existing enterprise application architectures and implement enhancements without disrupting current functionality.
* Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs and backend services supporting enterprise workflows.
* Integrate EMM platforms with internal systems and third\-party applications.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Develop microservices\-based applications adhering to enterprise architecture standards.
* Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and application modernization initiatives.
* Support and troubleshoot production applications, integrations, and enterprise workflows.
* Develop and maintain SSIS packages for ETL and enterprise data integration processes.
* Perform data transformation, mapping, validation, and error\-handling activities across multiple systems.
* Work closely with DevOps teams to implement CI/CD deployment pipelines.
* Support cloud\-native deployments and modernization initiatives using Azure services.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical best practices across the team.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.

Required Technical Skills
### **Core****Java****Development**


* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java backend development.
* Strong expertise in Java 8 or higher.
* Extensive experience with Spring Boot and enterprise backend application development.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
* Experience designing scalable microservices architectures.
* Expertise in REST API development and integration.

### **EMM****\&****Enterprise****Application****Customization**


* Hands\-on experience working with Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) platforms.
* Experience customizing, configuring, and extending enterprise applications.
* Ability to understand existing enterprise ecosystems and develop enhancements efficiently.
* Experience implementing business workflows and process automation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for enterprise applications and integrations.

### **Integration****\&****Middleware**


* Strong experience with JSON, XML, API integrations, and enterprise communication protocols.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications with third\-party platforms and internal systems.
* Knowledge of service\-oriented and event\-driven architectures.

### **SSIS****\&****Data****Integration**


* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
* Experience developing and maintaining ETL processes.
* Strong understanding of data extraction, transformation, and loading methodologies.
* Experience in database\-driven integrations and SQL Server optimization.
* Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing SSIS packages and jobs.

### **Database****Technologies**


* Strong knowledge of SQL Server and relational databases.
* Expertise in database design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience handling large\-volume enterprise data integrations.

### **Cloud****\&****DevOps**


* Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native backend development and deployment.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments in cloud environments.

Preferred / Optional Skills
### **Cloud****Modernization**


* Experience with Azure App Services.
* Azure Functions.
* Azure SQL Database.
* Azure Service Bus.
* Cloud migration and modernization projects.

### **Containerization****\&****DevOps**


* Experience with Docker.
* Kubernetes deployment and orchestration.
* Infrastructure automation and containerized application deployment.

### **AI****\&****Advanced****Integrations**


* Exposure to AI/GenAI\-enabled enterprise solutions.
* Experience integrating backend applications with AI Services and APIs.
* Understanding of AI\-driven workflow enhancements and intelligent automation.

### **Domain****Experience**


* Enterprise Marketing platforms and campaign management solutions.
* Customer engagement and marketing automation ecosystems.
* Legacy application modernization initiatives.
* Large\-scale enterprise transformation programs.

### **Methodologies**


* Agile / Scrum delivery experience.
* Production support and application enhancement activities.
* Cross\-functional collaboration within distributed teams.

What We Believe

We're proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we've been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. Today, those same values inspire us to encourage innovation, champion diversity and inclusion, and place people at the center of everything we do.


### **Humility**



We will listen, learn, be empathetic, and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.


### **Humanity**



Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.


### **Integrity**



We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.



All employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.



UST reserves the right to periodically redefine roles and responsibilities based on organizational requirements and employee performance.


* Support and promote UST values.
* Comply with all company policies and procedures.

Skills
### **Primary****Skills**


* Java
* Spring Boot
* Microservices
* EMM Customization
* SSIS
* SQL Server
* Azure
* REST APIs


  

**Skills**  

Microservices, Java, CI/CD, Spring Boot

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled **DevOps Engineer** with **4\+ years of experience** in designing, implementing, and managing cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with **AWS** and working knowledge of **Azure**, along with expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, cloud security, and automation. Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** or any other cloud platform will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Configure and maintain web servers, load balancers, reverse proxies, and networking components.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and security using cloud monitoring tools.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery, and high\-availability solutions.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and application\-related issues.
* Implement cloud security best practices, IAM policies, and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment efficiency and application reliability.

Required Skills

* 4\+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS** cloud services (EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, IAM, Route 53, ELB, Auto Scaling, Lambda, CloudWatch).
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft Azure**.
* Exposure to **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** or any other cloud platform is an added advantage.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration skills.
* Proficiency in Shell scripting (Bash) and/or Python.
* Experience with Git version control.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, DNS, SSL, VPN, firewalls, and load balancing.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Certifications such as **AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner**, **AWS Solutions Architect**, **AWS DevOps Engineer**, **Microsoft Azure Administrator/Engineer**, **CISM**, **CISSP**, or other relevant cloud/security certifications will be given preference.
* Experience with Ansible, Nginx, Apache, or other configuration management and web server technologies.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with modern cloud and DevOps technologies.
* Career growth and certification support.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Azure: 3 years (Required)
* Cloud architecture: 3 years (Required)
* DevOps: 4 years (Required)
* AWS: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------


Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward\-thinking, and experienced **Senior Data Engineer**, delivering results against some of the most complex business and technology initiatives.

  

This role will be a full\-time position based out of our Pune or Coimbatore office.  

  

If you are passionate about solving complex challenges and driving innovation – let's talk!  

  

Our organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  

The Senior Data Engineer drives data\-driven strategies and delivers impactful insights to optimize data platforms, analytics enablement, and business decision\-making. This role requires strong engineering depth across modern ELT tooling, analytical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to mentor and lead within a cross\-functional team.

 **Job Description**


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 **CERTIFICATIONS:**  

  

Preferred SnowPro Core and/or SnowPro Advanced certifications. dbt Certification (Analytics Engineer) is a plus.

 **EXPERIENCE:**

* 10–12 years of overall experience in IT, with a strong focus on data engineering and cloud data platforms.
* 6\+ years of architecture or engineering experience in data modeling, building data pipelines, ELT/ETL frameworks, data products, and distributed data systems.
* 6\+ years of experience within Data Warehousing: management (star schemas, snowflake schemas, dimensional modeling) within **Snowflake**.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with **dbt (data build tool)** — building and maintaining modular transformation layers, testing frameworks, macros, and documentation (dbt docs/lineage).
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with **Fivetran** (or similar managed ELT/connector tools) for automated data ingestion from SaaS, ERP, and database sources.
* 3\+ years of experience enabling or supporting BI/reporting layers using **Power BI** — including semantic modeling, DAX, and performance optimization of datasets feeding dashboards.
* Exposure to or working knowledge of **Generative AI** concepts and tools (LLM\-based data documentation/cataloging, natural\-language\-to\-SQL tools, AI\-assisted data quality or anomaly detection, Copilot\-style dev tooling) — hands\-on production experience is a plus, not mandatory.

**Nice to have:**

* 5\+ years of experience with Python for data engineering (scripting, automation, orchestration).
* Experience with PySpark for large\-scale data processing.
* Experience processing semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro).
* Exposure to orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or Snowflake Tasks/Streams).
* Familiarity with using LLMs/GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) to accelerate data engineering workflows — e.g., auto\-generating dbt documentation, AI\-assisted SQL/data quality checks, or building lightweight natural\-language query interfaces over Snowflake.

 **THOSE NECESSARY TO PERFORM THE JOB COMPETENTLY:**

* Thorough knowledge of Snowflake architecture (virtual warehouses, micro\-partitioning, clustering, cost/performance optimization).
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining **dbt** projects — models, tests, snapshots, incremental strategies, and CI/CD integration for dbt deployments.
* Strong hands\-on experience configuring and managing **Fivetran** connectors, sync schedules, transformations, and troubleshooting ingestion failures.
* Expertise in designing data models (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas) for both operational reporting and self\-service analytics.
* Should have worked on preparation of Technical Specification documents and data pipeline design documentation.
* Working knowledge of SAP systems as a source system (SAP ECC/S4HANA extraction patterns), integrated via Fivetran or custom pipelines into Snowflake.
* Experience enabling **Power BI** consumption layers — building/optimizing Snowflake views or dbt marts specifically for BI performance.
* Very good analytical skills to independently analyze and resolve ELT, SQL, and pipeline issues.
* Ability to provide effort estimation for data engineering initiatives.
* Ability to engage directly with business stakeholders, gather requirements, and work independently to translate them into scalable pipeline/data model designs.
* Advanced knowledge of data warehousing concepts and schema design trade\-offs.
* Curiosity and practical interest in applying **GenAI/LLM capabilities** to modernize data engineering workflows (e.g., automated documentation, natural\-language interfaces, intelligent data quality monitoring).
* SAP functional knowledge is good to have.

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**


Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science or other equivalent majors).

 **HOW YOU WILL THRIVE AND CREATE AN IMPACT:**

* Collaborate with the Analytics and BI teams to prototype and prove the viability of new data solutions, including GenAI\-assisted approaches where applicable.

Own the end\-to\-end data pipeline lifecycle: ingestion (Fivetran) transformation (dbt) storage/modeling (Snowflake)* consumption (Power BI).
* Lead development and execution of data engineering initiatives across specific projects, mentoring junior engineers on best practices.
* Be hands\-on in Snowflake development, dbt model design, and Fivetran pipeline configuration/administration.
* Explore and pilot GenAI use cases that improve data engineering productivity — e.g., AI\-assisted documentation, automated test generation, or natural\-language querying over the Snowflake warehouse.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating cross\-functionally with product owners, business stakeholders, and management.
* Provide technical leadership in the development of engineering standards (dbt style guides, naming conventions, testing coverage expectations).
* Comfortable with rapid prototyping and disciplined software development practices (version control, CI/CD, code review for dbt/SQL).
* Perform other duties as assigned.

 **Disclaimer:**  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.  

  

**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.  

  

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. **Apply today!**

title: Project Planner
description:
**Project Planner** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Experience: 9\+ years** 




**Qualification: BE/BTech Mechanical/Chemical or Diploma Mechanical** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Looking for a Project Planner with strong experience in project planning and Primavera P6 scheduling for large and complex EPC projects. The role will be responsible for developing Level 3 project schedules, detailed engineering schedules and manufacturing execution schedules, monitoring progress and supporting overall project management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and maintain Level 3 EPC project schedules using Primavera P6\.
* Prepare detailed engineering schedules and manufacturing execution schedules.
* Break down project plans into detailed activities, milestones and work packages and track planned vs. actual progress.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Fabrication, Quality and Project Management teams to ensure timely execution.
* Monitor manufacturing/fabrication activities, material availability, inspections, testing and dispatch against project schedules.
* Identify schedule delays and risks and support recovery planning and mitigation actions.
* Track weekly progress, task closures and schedule deviations and prepare project progress reports.
* Support resource planning and allocation across project activities.
* Coordinate with vendors, subcontractors and internal teams for timely completion of activities.
* Support project managers in overall project planning, execution and review.
* Lead/coordinate the planning team and ensure effective schedule monitoring.
* Travel to the manufacturing facility in Mangalore as required.



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 



* 10\+ years of experience in Project Planning / Project Controls.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Primavera P6\.
* Experience in developing Level 3 EPC schedules.
* Experience in both Detailed Engineering Planning and Manufacturing Execution Planning.
* Good understanding of fabrication/manufacturing project execution and shop\-floor activities.
* Experience in progress monitoring, planned vs. actual tracking and schedule control.
* Team handling experience.
* Experience in large EPC, engineering, fabrication or process equipment projects.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience in pressure vessels, process equipment, piping, modules or heavy engineering projects.
* Experience with manufacturing/fabrication units.
* MS Project knowledge.
* PMP certification.
* Willingness to travel to Mangalore on a need basis.

title: JJT Intern
description:
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 Career Programs
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Non\-LDP Intern/Co\-Op
   

  

**Job Category**
 Career Program
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 PENJERLA, Telangana, India
   

  

**Job Description**
**JJT ICC Internship Jan 2026**
 At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com
   

  

 The JJT Internship is an exciting two\-year career acceleration program crafted for college graduates with a real passion for a future in technology. We are committed in providing you with rich, meaningful experiences to learn and grow while helping you build the skillsets J\&J needs to become a future\-ready organization. Our program provides opportunities in roles such as business technologist and business analyst in areas such as Data Engineering \& Analytics, Data/Decision Science, Intelligent Automation, Cybersecurity, Customer (Digital) Experiences, Commercial Excellence, Software Engineering, Cloud/DevOps/Security, and Scientific \& Digital Health Technologies.
   

  

 While in the program, you will aspire to be an empowered and skilled technology engineer that can accelerate business value through agile delivery and human\-centered design approaches. You will have quicker access to the best technology and approaches to deliver at scale across the enterprise. Each employee should desire to challenge the status quo and possess a dedication to consistently exceed, to think creatively and implement innovative technical solutions that directly impact the customer, the patient and the community. Lastly, you should exhibit a combination of innate characteristics and learned skills that will be the driver in being a successful technology leader in a global healthcare organization.
   

  

**Program Components**
 This program consists of work assignments within the hiring country. You will be provided a comprehensive training curriculum including on the job, virtual, and in classroom training. Training topics focus on both job\-specific and professional development areas plus opportunities to receive certification in a number of specialized areas. You will also have access to mentors and coaching to provide support throughout the program. During your assignments, receive opportunities to participate in and/or lead projects which address real business and customer needs. Lastly you will improve your technical, business and professional skills while working in highly decentralized operating companies or headquarters organizations.
   

  

**Capability Responsibilities (include But Not Limited To)**
 Work closely with your supervisor to achieve goals \& objectives associated with your assigned capability area. See below for work descriptions within each capability:
   

  

* Full\-Stack Engineering: Focus on crafting custom, efficient, and reliable code that not only drives business outcomes but also fuels your growth and innovation in the tech space, across software and cloud
* Product Management: Hands\-on experience in crafting innovative solutions and transforming customer needs into impactful product stories across areas including Intelligent Automation, Customer Digital Experience, Commercial Health, and Scientific \& Digital Health
* Data Analytics: Maximize data in its raw format and elegantly engineer, transform, model, visualize, and stream it into the fabric of modern products and outstanding customer experiences
* Experience Design: Focus on user\-first approach, crafting experiences that are easy to use and purposeful; Looks at the human journey holistically to deliver a fully aligned, context\-driven experience, and help products reach their audiences in a way that deeply resonates with them

title: Sr. UX Research & Usability Professional8
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere.


We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone and grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?


Then come and join our global Design and User Experience Community as a **Sr. UX Research \& Usability Professional (UXR)** to generate actionable user insights, evaluate usability, and inform evidence\-based design decisions, driving design excellence and fostering the continuous evolution of digital healthcare solutions.


As part of our team, you will work on next\-generation healthcare solutions for healthcare professionals, patients, and customers. Supported by a collaborative global UX community, you will partner with cross\-functional teams to create impactful digital experiences and improve healthcare outcomes through the power of human\-centred design.

**Please upload your portfolio with your application.**

**Your tasks and responsibilities:**


As a **Senior User Research \& Usability Professional** , you will play a key role in shaping end\-to\-end healthcare experiences across digital solutions, products, and platforms, helping healthcare professionals work more efficiently and effectively.


In this role, you will be responsible for working across all stages of UX research and usability evaluation: identifying, planning, driving, conducting, analysing, and reporting research insights, while building an in depth understanding of users within the context of the business and product portfolio.

* Work closely with cross functional teams (UX, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and Business) to identify and evaluate research topics and clearly communicate research findings that increase empathy, inform decisions, and meet product evaluation criteria for usability, safety, and effectiveness.
* Conduct UX research and usability evaluation activities to inform requirements, evaluate concepts, and assess the usefulness and usability of products and services at formative and summative stages.
* Create and execute usability evaluation plans in compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable standards, aligning usability activities with project and business objectives.
* Apply a wide range of qualitative and quantitative research methods (e.g., generative research, task based usability testing, surveys, benchmarking) to understand and validate user needs, balancing business, technical, and regulatory requirements, and conducting research both in person and remotely.
* Contribute to risk management oriented usability evaluation, including identifying use related risks and supporting mitigation strategies, to help ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance.
* Responsible for producing clear, audit ready usability documentation, including research plans, protocols, study reports, and traceability of findings to design decisions and risk controls.
* Represent user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring user insights are reflected in product direction and strategic decision\-making.
* Contribute to a strong UX culture by championing design quality, fostering collaboration, and driving the continuous improvement of healthcare experiences across our global design organization.

  

**Work Experience**  

**Your qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Social Sciences, HCI, Computer Science, Usability Engineering, or a related field focused on human behavior.
* 7\+ years of professional experience in UX research and usability evaluation/engineering. Experience in the medical technology or healthcare domain is strongly preferred.
* Proven expertise in Usability Evaluation and a thorough understanding of IEC standards (e.g., IEC 62366\) and human factors principles.
* Hands\-on experience with medical device development, FDA clearance/approval processes, and/or regulated product documentation. Demonstrated ability to plan, conduct, and formally document formative and summative usability studies
* Proven experience collaborating with product, design, engineering, and regulatory teams to translate research findings into product requirements, design improvements, and usability risk mitigations.

**Your attributes and skills**

* A user\-centered mindset with deep expertise in usability, human factors, and user centered design applied to complex healthcare systems.
* Proven ability to plan, conduct, and synthesize usability research, translating insights into actionable design and risk mitigation recommendations.
* Strong understanding of healthcare workflows, clinical contexts, and patient safety considerations, with hands on experience working within regulated environments and the ability to produce clear, audit ready documentation.
* Comfort working in cross functional and multidisciplinary environments, with a detail oriented and methodical approach that balances rigor with pragmatism in fast moving product teams.

**Your Mindset**

* Forward\-thinking and quality\-driven mindset: A forward thinking UX research and usability practitioner who drives evidence based decision making through close collaboration. You position usability as a critical input to product quality and safety. You anticipate usability risks and advocate for user needs with clear, data backed rationale in cross functional discussions
* Collaborative ownership mindset: You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and initiative in problem solving, confidently aligning UX and usability strategies with business goals. You balance user needs with business realities to drive impactful, innovative solutions. You are self directed, proactive, and capable of owning usability activities end to end, while fostering a collaborative and accountable team culture
* Continuous learning mindset: You actively seek learning opportunities and continuously expand your skills. Curious and adaptive, you stay up to date with emerging UX, usability, and healthcare trends, using new insights to enhance both personal effectiveness and the value you bring to the team and business.


To gain a deeper understanding of the products and services related to this role, please explore these links and visit our company website for more details. https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/products\-services

**Our global team:**


We are a team of 66,000 highly dedicated employees across more than 70 countries passionately pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare to help improve people’s lives around the world. As a leader in the industry, we aspire to create better outcomes and experiences for patients no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio, spanning from in\-vitro and in\-vivo diagnostics to image\-guided therapy and innovative cancer care, is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.

**Our culture:**


We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success. Check our Careers Site


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.


We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.
